gen-dafont-impact-label-fs-asap: Commanding and heavy, Impact Label stamps each letter out on its own, like beads on a rod, with a high x-height. Asap follows with open arcs.
gen-dafont-bloody-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Be Vietnam Pro reads clean and unfussy, its curve endings far apart. Bloody's big round bowls give the heading a mean, dripping punch above that sans.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-archivo: Raw and tactical, Capture Smallz fills its lowercase with big bodies. Archivo follows in a plain sans, curves opening outward, so paragraphs move along with an editorial, approachable pull.
gen-dafont-galaxy-fs-merriweather-sans: Merriweather Sans reads sturdy and large, its tall lowercase making each word look planted. Merriweather Sans keeps that going across a long stretch, the e's eye opening clearly to the right, so lines stay easy to follow.
gen-dafont-nordic-fs-asap: Ancient and powerful, Nordic draws wirelike strokes of one thickness with cramped, nearly closed letters, while Asap opens its c forms into easy arcs. The two meet in the middle.
gen-audiowide-gf-julius-sans-one: Futuristic tiles with wide gaps: Audiowide sets tall lowercase with no thick-thin shift, while Julius Sans One stays light with open-ended curves. Longer text there feels spacious and gentle.
gen-dafont-conthrax-archivo: Wide, geometric and tall in the lowercase, Conthrax draws every stroke at the same gauge, so its capitals barely rise above the bodies. Conthrax is built to make a statement; Archivo is built for sustained reading, with a commanding x-height.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-fs-ranade: Ranade reads organic and spread out, its stroke ends set far apart with only a slight shift in weight. Jelly Crazies is the one for wobbly, nearly sealed bowls in a single outline thickness; Ranade is better at carrying open, restrained text.
gen-dafont-joystix-fs-merriweather-sans: Joystix brings bold arcade energy, with widely tracked letters and stems barely heavier than their arms. Merriweather Sans is the one for reading, with tall lowercase that looks sturdy and an e that opens to the right.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-graduate: Wobbly and playful, Jelly Crazies slows everything to a leisurely walk with bowls that nearly seal shut. And Graduate, a dignified classic serif with generous white between letters, keeps a long passage steady and bookish.
